svg.title: Selecting a section keeps its owned features
svg.desc: The west_approach section and its owned crosswalk and generated signs remain at full opacity. The neighboring intersection and global actor are faded context for this illustration and are absent from the selected export. The actor is moved toward the intersection for this illustration only. The colored section outline, actor outline, handles, and labels are guide annotations. The excerpt uses local Map coordinates without the output's display rotation.
